oracle_contracts.name: Trade the Helm
oracle_contracts.oracle:
Exchange control of target artifact or creature you control and target artifact or creature an opponent controls.
Cycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)
oracle_contracts.roles: required own artifact-or-creature group0 and required opponent artifact-or-creature group1; both roles remain independently qualified against the original packet controller
oracle_contracts.outcome: Both legal -> simultaneous permanent exchange; either illegal or absent -> no exchange. If another effect swaps both before resolution, both targets become illegal and their new controllers remain.

oracle_contracts.name: Demonic Junker
oracle_contracts.oracle:
Affinity for artifacts (This spell costs {1} less to cast for each artifact you control.)
When this Vehicle enters, for each player, destroy up to one target creature that player controls. If a creature you controlled was destroyed this way, put two +1/+1 counters on this Vehicle.
Crew 2
oracle_contracts.roles: optional own creature group0 and optional opposing creature group1; each checked against original queued controller
oracle_contracts.outcome: Destroy every remaining legal target in one deduplicated simultaneous batch; once-only reward iff actual destruction includes original queued-controller creature. Counters require exact source still on battlefield, even if source control changed.
